scope: development evaluation only; sequences previously used in demo/rule development; not an independent test
checkpoint_training_data: COCO pretrained by publisher; no local vehicle fine-tuning
ignored_region_policy: COCO crowd ignore per evaluated category; valid objects matched before crowd; IoA for crowd
ground_truth_coordinates: source XML xywh unchanged, including annotated boxes partly outside image
category_policy: localization merges all source vehicle types and vehicle predictions; common-class AP evaluates car/bus only, van/others become ignore areas; no others-to-truck relabeling
selection_policy: fixed before computing this evaluation; do not tune using these results or claim camera independence
